description:
One ``.himg`` data-management job over a HASO device folder.

The file's stem is the ID groups and the portal refer to.  ``device``
is the HASO device whose folder under ``scans/ScanNNN/`` holds the
``.himg`` files; it also names the stamp column of the scan's rows and
the stack file.

schema_version.description: Format version of this job file. Leave at 1 — tools update this automatically when the file format changes.
schema_version.title: Schema Version

kind.description: Which job: himg_to_stack (folder → capture stack), himg_compact (verify, then delete the .himg files — destructive) or himg_restore (rebuild the .himg files from the stack).
kind.title: Kind

device.description: The HASO device whose folder under scans/ScanNNN/ holds the .himg files.
device.title: Device

output_name.description: Label the portal's Analysis tab lists the job under. Defaults to device; the job writes nothing under analysis/.
output_name.title: Output Name
